RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of discrimination, nor is hiring a qualified candidate with fewer years of experience. Leadership roles like group head prioritize client acquisition, commercial acumen, and team leadership over raw technical tenure; both candidates met the chartered standard. 

Accusing the panel of gender bias based purely on demographics is speculative and would severely damage your professional reputation and industry relationships. Furthermore, delays in HR feedback are standard administrative lag, not an admission of wrongdoing. 

Do not raise sex or panel composition. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on specific leadership and business development competencies to understand how you can strengthen future applications.
